# dsh-agent-teams-dashboard

A DSH Web plugin that adds a **Teams** section («Команды») to the sidebar and a
dashboard for every

AgentTeams chat: active runs and teams finished in the last
three days, token spend with time-range

controls, cost in USD and RUB, total and
union work time, team cards with the orca roster and task r

oadmap, and an
archive for older teams.

The plugin has two halves: a host half (`index.js` + `lib/host/`) that reads DSH
and AgentTeams stat

e read-only and serves two loopback JSON routes, and a
browser half (`lib/client.js`) that renders t

he panel inside the DSH shell. The
panel never talks to the outside world: it calls its own same-ori

nside the DSH shell. The
panel never talks to the outside world: it calls its own same-origin route.

Both screenshots come from the offline preview harness with synthetic demo data;
no owner data is us
ed anywhere in this repository.
## Features

- Sidebar section «Команды» (panel id `agent-teams-dashboard`, order 10) with a
live dot while a tea

m is working.
- Ranges: Today, 7 days (default), 30 days, All time and a custom period picker.
- Thr

ee hero cards: tokens (cache / input / output, stacked by day), cost
(USD primary, RUB always visibl

e, CBR rate with date and stale/override
markers) and time (total work time plus the merged "online"

time).
- Team grid: title that shrinks 13 → 12 → 11 px and clamps to two lines, a
coloured status d

ot with a word (active, waiting, halted, stalled, completed,
unknown), captain and member orca artwo

rk with a monogram fallback, a
dependency-ordered task roadmap with a segmented progress bar, and a

one-line
metrics footer.
- Archive view with search by title and sorting by end date, title or spend

opens the team chat (the captain session)
through the shell navigation; a missing session shows a to

ast instead of
navigating.
- Skeleton, empty, range-empty, error, stale and partial states; one brok

en
`team.json` never blanks the dashboard — it becomes a warning strip while the
rest stays visible.

- Dark and light themes driven by DSH tokens, keyboard focus, a polite live
region, reduced motion,
and RU/EN dictionaries.
## Install

Requirements: DSH Web with client-plugin support (`dsh.engines.dsh >= 0.2.0-rc.2`)
and, for the data
itself, the AgentTeams plugin (`@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`).
### Install from git (recommended)
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Replace `<profile>` with your DSH profile name (for the Desktop app the default
profile is usually `

desktop`). Restart the host when the command finishes; the
loader mounts the plugin's `cordis.patch.
yml` row automatically.
### Install from the Desktop plugin manager
Open **Settings → Plugins**, choose "Install from Git URL" and paste:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Confirm the install and restart the host. The plugin appears in the sidebar as
«Команды».
## Privacy
The plugin is read-only over your DSH home and workspaces:

- `<DSH_HOME>/storages/workspace.json` — the workspace and session registry;
- `<DSH_HOME>/storages/

session_projcache/sessions/*.json` — session projections
(title, token buckets, daily cost, last act

e>/.agent-teams/archive/<team>/team.json` — roster, tasks, status
flags.

It never reads message content, never reads the AgentTeams mailboxes
(`inbox/*.jsonl` is out of scop

e), sends no telemetry and writes exactly one
file: the exchange-rate cache at
`<DSH_HOME>/cache/dsh
-teams-dashboard/fx.json`. That file is safe to delete.
The only outbound requests are the two CBR endpoints:

- `https://www.cbr.ru/scripts/XML_daily.asp` (primary);
- `https://www.cbr-xml-daily.ru/daily_json.j

.cbr.ru/scripts/XML_daily.asp` (primary);
- `https://www.cbr-xml-daily.ru/daily_json.js` (fallback).

Disable them with `fxEnabled: false`; the plugin then uses the last cached rate
or the baked rate an

d marks the snapshot as stale. Both panel routes answer only
on loopback (127.0.0.1 / ::1): a remote

caller gets `403 forbidden:
loopback-only`. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

The public repository and its fixtures/screenshots contain synthetic demo data
only. `scripts/check-
public.mjs` enforces this before every release.
## Compatibility

- DSH Web `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` with client-plugin support (the `dsh.client` bundle
entry and `sidebar.pan

ellist` / `main` slots).
- Node.js 24 or newer for the test suite, the checks and the offline previe

w
harness; the plugin itself has no runtime dependencies.
- AgentTeams (`@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams

`) is optional to mount but required
for data: without it the dashboard is empty, and the whale artw

ork falls back
to monogram badges.
- Windows, macOS and Linux. Windows paths are handled with `path.

join`/`resolve`
and the same long-path encoding DSH uses.
## Limitations

- Tokens and cost are day-grained: DSH's `contextActivity` only stores daily
buckets, so "Today" is

one bar and sub-day cost is not available.
- Cost is an estimate from the published DeepSeek CNY pri

ces and the dated CBR
rate, not a provider invoice. Unknown provider/models count tokens but leave
c

ost empty ("—", never 0).
- RUB depends on the exchange rate; offline with no cache the baked rate i

s used
and marked stale.
- The routes are loopback-only; a remote Web UI receives 403.
- Teams are d

iscovered only under registered workspace paths; a stray
`.agent-teams` directory is counted, not re

ndered.
- Removed members stay in history and attribution but never count as live.
- Long archives a

re not virtualised; `content-visibility: auto` is the only
mitigation.
- Artwork comes from the inst

alled AgentTeams plugin; missing images degrade to
monograms.
- The preview harness mounts the real

bundle in a mock shell; it does not
exercise the real shell's navigation service, focus ring or slot

a mock shell; it does not
exercise the real shell's navigation service, focus ring or slot geometry.
